Rust cores, caramel halos, edges feathered 3–6 cm, NO splatter. Pleats basted shut while painting (faces painted, underlays stay base colour). Plackets, yoke, sleeves, collar, waistband, loops: never painted.

Template: shirt unit above, trouser legs below, the shirt hem touching the trouser waistband seam (laid flat). As worn the shirt hem falls at H = 26 cm below the trouser waistband top: the streaks run on across it. Other sizes: scale per table P-2.
